desc: Derive the probability that a fixed edge created by vertex k lies on the path between arbitrary vertices u<v.
Re-derive and prove the correct joint descendant probability for k<u<v; resolve the failed u-dependent formula.
Derive the revised O(1) prefix-sum expected-distance formula, including any additional weighted prefix sums required.
Verify the revised formula on small N by enumerating all valid parent sequences and comparing totals.
Implement the verified O(N+Q) Python solution with modular inverses, factorial scaling, and fast stdin/stdout.
